reviews.text: A great place to find everything your dogs need
They have a good selection of things for small dogs, but not as much variety for large dogs.
Not many cat furniture, no litter, very little of food. This pet store is a dog store. Not made for cat at all which is a bit disappointing
Great place for dog and cat lover
The staff are so nice, and they have tons of cute clothes – it's the best! They also have snacks, carts, and pretty much all the dog supplies you need. 😊 …

I was looking to buy pet clothes, but the staff were unfriendly and kept refolding them one after another, which was really unpleasant. You can't tell unless you look closely, and if they don't want their pets touched, why don't they put them in a clear bag? It made me not want to buy anything.
Got super cute products and very friendly staff:)
Good store. Good service. Many cute clothes for pets. The clothes are refreshed regularly.

I use this pet spa every month. The staff are very nice and always greet me with a smile, making the time I spend with them relaxing. They were very helpful with my three Chihuahuas' first grooming session.

I've been using this salon since my dog ​​was a puppy. I always look forward to it because they take photos on their smartphone during and after the grooming session, dressing him up in seasonal attire, and upload them to Instagram!

If they find any skin irritations like eczema during the grooming session, they take a photo of the affected area and give it to me, which makes it easier to take to the vet.

Some people have written negative reviews saying that they "use their smartphone," but taking photos is just part of the service, right?


Perhaps because it's so popular, they've stopped accepting new puppies, so you have to wait for a spot to open up, but the staff are always smiling and kind, and you can really tell they love animals.


They also sell a lot of stylish and cute clothes and leashes, so I usually get most of my dog's gear here. They change everything with the seasons, so it's fun just looking at them!
Definitely THE BEST place to buy things for pets! 💕🫶🏼 …
